native_tips: QQ / Q彈 describes chewy texture and is a key Taiwanese food word.
南北之爭 (north-south rivalry) over food is a favourite light-hearted debate.
Podcast chat is casual: 對啊, 真的, 然後, 就是說 fill pauses.
opening_line: 哈囉大家好，歡迎收聽本集節目！今天我們請到一位外國朋友來聊台灣小吃。先問你，你吃過最「台」的東西是什麼？

title: Discussing 那些年: book versus film
title_zh: 聊《那些年》的小說與電影
setting: A bookstore café on a Sunday evening after a book-club rewatch of the 2011 film 《那些年，我們一起追的女孩》. Copies of 九把刀's novel lie on the table, full of sticky notes.
ai_role: 欣怡, a book-club member who grew up in 彰化, is a big 九把刀 fan and has strong opinions about the book versus the film.
learner_role: A reader who has just finished (or is still reading) the novel.
goals: Compare the novel and the film
Discuss the characters and the ending
Relate the story to your own school days

key_phrases.zh: 我覺得小說比電影更細膩。
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ jué de xiǎo shuō bǐ diàn yǐng gèng xì nì.
key_phrases.en: I think the novel is more nuanced than the film.

key_phrases.zh: 柯景騰那種幼稚又真誠的個性，很像我高中的同學。
key_phrases.pinyin: kē jǐng téng nà zhǒng yòu zhì yòu zhēn chéng de gè xìng, hěn xiàng wǒ gāo zhōng de tóng xué.
key_phrases.en: 柯景騰's childish yet sincere personality is just like my high-school classmates.
key_phrases.note: 柯景騰 is the narrator and 九把刀's real name.

key_phrases.zh: 沈佳宜代表的是每個人心中那個「好學生」。
key_phrases.pinyin: shěn jiā yí dài biǎo de shì měi ge rén xīn zhōng nà ge hǎo xué shēng.
key_phrases.en: 沈佳宜 represents the 'good student' everyone remembers.

key_phrases.zh: 書裡的口語很道地，有很多台灣用語跟髒話。
key_phrases.pinyin: shū lǐ de kǒu yǔ hěn dào dì, yǒu hěn duō tái wān yòng yǔ gēn zāng huà.
key_phrases.en: The dialogue in the book is very authentic, full of Taiwanese expressions and swearing.

key_phrases.zh: 結局讓我很遺憾，但也很真實。
key_phrases.pinyin: jié jú ràng wǒ hěn yí hàn, dàn yě hěn zhēn shí.
key_phrases.en: The ending left me with regret, but it feels real.

key_phrases.zh: 如果是你，你會跟她告白嗎？
key_phrases.pinyin: rú guǒ shì nǐ, nǐ huì gēn tā gào bái ma?
key_phrases.en: If it were you, would you have confessed to her?

native_tips: The film's English title is 'You Are the Apple of My Eye', and its theme song 〈那些年〉 by 胡夏 was a huge hit.
The story is set at 精誠中學 in 彰化, 九把刀's own school.
Fans often discuss 遺憾 (regret) and 青春 (youth) as the story's core themes; avoid spoilers for people still reading.
opening_line: 你也看完了嗎？我每次看到最後婚禮那段都會哭欸！你覺得書跟電影哪個比較好？

title: Debating a social issue
setting: A university general-education seminar room. Today's structured debate is on housing prices and 居住正義; a timer is on the screen and classmates are taking notes.
ai_role: 林同學, a sharp debater assigned to the opposing side, who demands evidence and pounces on weak logic.
learner_role: A debater arguing that the government should act more strongly on housing.
goals: State a clear position with supporting reasons
Rebut the opponent's argument politely but firmly
Acknowledge complexity and conclude

key_phrases.zh: 我的立場是政府應該更積極地打房。
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ de lì chǎng shì zhèng fǔ yīng gāi gèng jī jí de dǎ fáng.
key_phrases.en: My position is that the government should curb housing speculation more actively.
key_phrases.note: 打房 = government measures to cool the housing market (Taiwan term).

key_phrases.zh: 根據統計，台北的房價所得比是全台最高的。
key_phrases.pinyin: gēn jù tǒng jì, tái běi de fáng jià suǒ dé bǐ shì quán tái zuì gāo de.
key_phrases.en: According to statistics, Taipei's house-price-to-income ratio is the highest in Taiwan.

key_phrases.zh: 我不同意你的看法，因為你忽略了租屋族的處境。
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ bù tóng yì nǐ de kàn fǎ, yīn wèi nǐ hū lüè le zū wū zú de chǔ jìng.
key_phrases.en: I disagree, because you ignore the situation of renters.

key_phrases.zh: 換個角度來看，這也是世代正義的問題。
key_phrases.pinyin: huàn ge jiǎo dù lái kàn, zhè yě shì shì dài zhèng yì de wèn tí.
key_phrases.en: From another angle, this is also an issue of intergenerational justice.

key_phrases.zh: 你這個論點有邏輯上的漏洞。
key_phrases.pinyin: nǐ zhè ge lùn diǎn yǒu luó jí shàng de lòu dòng.
key_phrases.en: Your argument has a logical gap.

key_phrases.zh: 這是一個兩難的問題，沒有標準答案。
key_phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge liǎng nán de wèn tí, méi yǒu biāo zhǔn dá àn.
key_phrases.en: This is a dilemma; there's no single right answer.

key_phrases.pinyin: zòng shàng suǒ shù, wǒ rèn wéi……
key_phrases.en: In summary, I believe…
key_phrases.note: Taiwan reads 綜 as zòng (ㄗㄨㄥˋ); mainland zōng.

native_tips: Other live Taiwan debate topics: 少子化, 低薪, 核能, 死刑, 長照; the AI can swap topics.
Formal debate uses 對方辯友 for 'my opponent'.
Even heated debates keep polite markers like 我尊重你的看法，但是……
opening_line: 好，今天的辯題是「政府應該用更強硬的手段打房」。我站反方，請你先陳述你的立場。

title: Negotiating salary
setting: An HR meeting room at a semiconductor-related company in 新竹科學園區. You have just received an offer, and HR has asked you to come in to discuss terms.
ai_role: Grace, an HR manager: professional, budget-conscious, fluent in HR jargon (月薪, 年薪, 保障, 分紅, 職等).
learner_role: A candidate negotiating a better package.
goals: Thank the company and signal interest
Justify a higher salary with market data and experience
Negotiate bonuses or other terms and ask for time to decide

key_phrases.zh: 謝謝貴公司的錄取，我很期待加入。
key_phrases.pinyin: xiè xie guì gōng sī de lù qǔ, wǒ hěn qí dài jiā rù.
key_phrases.en: Thank you for the offer, I'm looking forward to joining.

key_phrases.zh: 關於薪資的部分，我想再跟您討論一下。
key_phrases.pinyin: guān yú xīn zī de bù fèn, wǒ xiǎng zài gēn nín tǎo lùn yí xià.
key_phrases.en: Regarding salary, I'd like to discuss it a bit more.

key_phrases.zh: 根據我的經驗跟市場行情，我希望年薪能到一百二十萬。
key_phrases.pinyin: gēn jù wǒ de jīng yàn gēn shì chǎng háng qíng, wǒ xī wàng nián xīn néng dào yì bǎi èr shí wàn.
key_phrases.en: Based on my experience and the market rate, I'd hope for an annual salary of 1.2 million.

key_phrases.zh: 請問年終跟員工分紅大概是幾個月？
key_phrases.pinyin: qǐng wèn nián zhōng gēn yuán gōng fēn hóng dà gài shì jǐ ge yuè?
key_phrases.en: Roughly how many months are the year-end bonus and profit sharing?

key_phrases.zh: 如果底薪沒辦法調整，那簽約獎金有沒有空間？
key_phrases.pinyin: rú guǒ dǐ xīn méi bàn fǎ tiáo zhěng, nà qiān yuē jiǎng jīn yǒu méi yǒu kōng jiān?
key_phrases.en: If the base salary can't change, is there room on a signing bonus?

key_phrases.zh: 我需要一點時間考慮，可以週五前回覆您嗎？
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ xū yào yì diǎn shí jiān kǎo lǜ, kě yǐ zhōu wǔ qián huí fù nín ma?
key_phrases.en: I need some time to consider; may I reply by Friday?

native_tips: Packages are described as 月薪 × months, e.g. 年薪保障14個月.
Tech companies in 竹科 often have large 分紅 (profit-sharing) components.
Indirect phrasing (是否有空間、能不能再討論) is more effective than blunt demands.
opening_line: 您好，恭喜您通過面試。我們這邊開給您的條件是月薪七萬，年終保障兩個月，不知道您覺得如何？

title: Discussing the news
setting: Sunday brunch at an 早午餐 café. Your friend slides his phone across the table: a headline about labour shortages and Taiwan's record-low birth rate.
ai_role: 博文, a journalist friend at a newspaper: analytical, sceptical, plays devil's advocate and uses news vocabulary.
learner_role: A friend who follows Taiwanese news.
goals: Summarise a news story in your own words
Analyse causes and evaluate policies
Discuss media bias and sources

key_phrases.zh: 你有看到今天的頭條嗎？
key_phrases.pinyin: nǐ yǒu kàn dào jīn tiān de tóu tiáo ma?
key_phrases.en: Did you see today's headline?

key_phrases.zh: 台灣的生育率是全世界最低的國家之一。
key_phrases.pinyin: tái wān de shēng yù lǜ shì quán shì jiè zuì dī de guó jiā zhī yī.
key_phrases.en: Taiwan's birth rate is among the lowest in the world.

key_phrases.zh: 問題的根源在於低薪跟高房價。
key_phrases.pinyin: wèn tí de gēn yuán zài yú dī xīn gēn gāo fáng jià.
key_phrases.en: The root of the problem lies in low wages and high housing prices.

key_phrases.zh: 政府推出的補助真的有用嗎？
key_phrases.pinyin: zhèng fǔ tuī chū de bǔ zhù zhēn de yǒu yòng ma?
key_phrases.en: Do the government's subsidies actually work?

key_phrases.zh: 這篇報導的立場好像有點偏頗。
key_phrases.pinyin: zhè piān bào dǎo de lì chǎng hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn piān pō.
key_phrases.en: This report seems a bit biased.

key_phrases.zh: 我們不能只看標題，要看完整的數據。
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ men bù néng zhǐ kàn biāo tí, yào kàn wán zhěng de shù jù.
key_phrases.en: We can't just read headlines; we need the full data.

native_tips: News vocabulary: 少子化, 缺工, 高齡化, 通膨, 立法院, 行政院.
Taiwanese media is often described as polarised; people discuss 媒體識讀 (media literacy).
Use hedges like 據報導, 有專家認為 to sound measured.
opening_line: 欸，你看這則新聞——「缺工問題創新高」。你覺得問題出在哪裡？

title: An academic seminar discussion
setting: A graduate seminar room at 台大. The topic is the differences between 台灣華語 and mainland 普通話; a professor sits at the head of the table with printed readings.
ai_role: 鄭教授, a sociolinguistics professor: Socratic, precise, and fond of asking 'what's your evidence?'.
learner_role: A graduate student presenting observations and arguing a point.
goals: Present observations about Taiwan Mandarin with examples
Use academic structure and terminology
Respond to challenges and qualify your claims

key_phrases.zh: 我想從語音、詞彙跟語法三個層面來分析。
key_phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng cóng yǔ yīn, cí huì gēn yǔ fǎ sān ge céng miàn lái fēn xī.
key_phrases.en: I'd like to analyse this on three levels: phonology, vocabulary and grammar.

key_phrases.zh: 台灣華語受到閩南語很深的影響，例如「有」字句。
key_phrases.pinyin: tái wān huá yǔ shòu dào mǐn nán yǔ hěn shēn de yǐng xiǎng, lì rú yǒu zì jù.
key_phrases.en: Taiwan Mandarin is deeply influenced by Southern Min, for example the 有 + verb construction.

key_phrases.zh: 這個現象可以用語言接觸的理論來解釋。
key_phrases.pinyin: zhè ge xiàn xiàng kě yǐ yòng yǔ yán jiē chù de lǐ lùn lái jiě shì.
key_phrases.en: This phenomenon can be explained by language-contact theory.

key_phrases.zh: 就我所知，相關的研究還不多。
key_phrases.pinyin: jiù wǒ suǒ zhī, xiāng guān de yán jiù hái bù duō.
key_phrases.en: As far as I know, there isn't much research on this yet.
key_phrases.note: Taiwan reads 究 as jiù (ㄐㄧㄡˋ); mainland jiū.

key_phrases.zh: 老師，我想補充一個例子。
key_phrases.pinyin: lǎo shī, wǒ xiǎng bǔ chōng yí ge lì zi.
key_phrases.en: Professor, I'd like to add an example.

key_phrases.zh: 這個結論是否能推論到其他地區？
key_phrases.pinyin: zhè ge jié lùn shì fǒu néng tuī lùn dào qí tā dì qū?
key_phrases.en: Can this conclusion be generalised to other regions?

native_tips: In Taiwan, students usually address professors as 老師, not 教授, in conversation.
Academic register favours 是否, 之, 而, 就……而言, and 換言之.
Hedging (可能, 在某種程度上) is expected when making claims.
opening_line: 好，今天我們討論台灣華語跟普通話的差異。你先說說看，你自己觀察到最明顯的差別是什麼？
